title: Virtual Compute: evt invoice
content:
## Formal basis

Virtual Compute — No posted charge exists for the same source event, meter, source subtype, pricing component and billing period. Group service charges by invoice grouping basis. Billing periods follow billing cycle in billing timezone, beginning at the first instant of the first date and ending exclusively at the first instant of the next month. For measured usage, invoice only services whose interval has ended; lifecycle fees instead require their source occurrence to be completed; use the posted authoritative source records. Set invoice issue time to the frozen handling time. Carry forward a positive grouped subtotal below minimum invoice amount rather than issuing an invoice; zero-rated usage stays visible as a meter and receives no monetary charge. A source charge already posted for the same source event, meter, quantity component and invoice period is returned without another charge. The fixed source reference and source subtype distinguish primary, supplemental, setup, termination, resumption and return-fee components.

## Evidence — unbilled source component

For charge, No posted charge exists for the same source event, meter, source subtype, pricing component and billing period. Before this action, authoritative system records establish the condition using evidence event reference, original source reference, meter kind, source subtype, pricing component, period, event type, status. Those records correlate to the current action by original source reference.
